employees.basis: employees (headcount at the end of fiscal 2026)

source.label: FY2026 Form 10-K, Item 1A Risk Factors
source.quote: from the end of fiscal 2025 to the end of fiscal 2026, our headcount increased from 16,068 to 21,921 employees, including approximately 4,223 additional headcount as a result of the CyberArk acquisition.

payroll.label: Median of the annual total compensation of all employees in fiscal 2026

source.label: 2026 proxy statement (DEF 14A), CEO Pay Ratio
source.quote: The median of the annual total compensation of all employees of our Company and our consolidated subsidiaries in fiscal 2026 was approximately $260,431, excluding our Chief Executive Officer.

notes: Employees: year-end head count stated in the FY2026 10-K risk factors (the human capital section gives no number). Payroll: the FY2026 10-K discloses no total staff cost, so the proxy's CEO pay ratio median is used; it is for fiscal 2026, identified from the population of about 21,173 employees at May 1, 2026, excluding about 3,864 CyberArk employees acquired on February 11, 2026. It includes the grant-date fair value of equity awards, so it is far above cash pay.
